description: A snowy cobbled street at night, lit by a gas lamp on the right and warm windows in brick buildings behind. A tall man with dark swept-back hair, in a brown patterned quilted coat over a white shirt and cream apron, stoops with an outstretched hand and a tearful expression toward a small ragged boy in a torn coat and scarf, who stands holding a wooden crutch. The clothing and street are Dickensian, Victorian-era. Falling snow throughout. A tiny multicolored logo sits in the bottom-right corner. The painting runs edge to edge with no frame or border.
